title: Incomplete penetrance with obligate carriers
goal: Show a dominant variant with an unaffected obligate carrier and affected descendant.

rubric.must: The pedigree visibly shows an affected founder.
The drawing visibly shows an unaffected obligate carrier parent.
The drawing visibly marks an affected proband child.
Roman generation labels and individual identifiers are visibly ordered across generations.
Standard pedigree sex and affected/carrier symbol fills are visibly distinguishable.
Partnership and parent-child lines make biological relationships unambiguous.

ideal.notes: Affected founder I-1 passes the variant through clinically unaffected obligate carrier II-1, drawn with a central dot, to affected proband III-1.
